title: Motor execution dataset from Wairagkar et al 2018
description: A preprocessed EEG dataset from 14 healthy participants performing motor imagery tasks, consisting of 1,665 trials across three conditions: right-hand imagery, left-hand imagery, and rest. Recorded at 1024 Hz using 19 EEG channels with a standard 10-20 montage, the dataset includes asynchronous motor imagery paradigm data with visual cues. This derivative dataset was processed using ICA artifact removal and frequency filtering, and is accompanied by HED event annotations for standardized interpretation.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 1024 Hz from 19 channels (Ag/AgCl ring sensors) using a Deymed TruScan 32 system with standard 10-20 montage. Preprocessing included DC offset removal, 0.5 Hz high-pass filter, 50 Hz notch filter, 60 Hz low-pass filter, and ICA artifact removal (EEGLAB infomax). Trials were segmented from -3 to +3 seconds around movement onset. Participants performed asynchronous voluntary finger tapping tasks (right tap, left tap, resting state) cued by visual text stimuli within 10-second windows.
